TRANSACTION DETAILS

Sales terms

Pre-orders are closed. Seller identity, address, phone number, shipping cost, delivery timing, cancellation terms, inventory limits, and final tax-inclusive totals must all be published before payment can open.

Payment and order confirmation

When sales open, the final review page displays the product, quantity, total including tax and shipping, payment method, estimated delivery, cancellation terms, and seller information before Stripe Checkout opens. Payment status is confirmed only by a signed Stripe webhook.
